title: How Far Could Alphabet Stock Move On You In A Year?
summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) stock trades at about $332, and options expiring roughly a year out price a 68% probability range running from roughly $233 to roughly $474. That floor sits just under the stock's 52-week low of $235.96, while the ceiling clears its 52-week high of $402.12. Yet, a range this wide is close to normal for these shares, not a sign of unusual fear.
